selected_evidence.summary: UFW is active and enabled at boot. Its persisted rules survived reboot with an unchanged checksum and remained active in the final state.
Final rules allow TCP 22 from Anywhere and Anywhere (v6); post-restart connections from node2 and node3 received the OpenSSH banner.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow TCP 9000 only from node2 and reject node3/everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: With a live listener on node1:9000 after reboot, node2 received HTTP 200 while node3 received an active connection refusal. Final rules contain the node2-specific allow before the IPv4/IPv6 catch-all reject.

Healthy baseline boot ID 29011044-5356-46eb-ba9c-1470170355a7, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 71311c12-5c86-48fa-b6e5-bf8cc34b7ada, recovered UFW/SSH/filesystem state, and correct live firewall behavior.

Healthy baseline boot ID 17b362d1-c234-4169-bc4e-114d01fdf401, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 778a595a-763e-4772-8205-98a18450d62a, running system with zero failed units, and restored authorized access to node1:9000.
